schema: fracture-md DFT literature values v0.1: published values of the SAME functional (PBE) used as literature_model_value evidence by examples/dft/stage1_validation.py (engines.dft_qe.LiteratureValue)

how_to_read.property: fracture_md PropertyName value of the record the evidence is attached to
how_to_read.index: element of an array record ([0,0] = C11, [0,1] = C12, [3,3] = C44 of elastic_stiffness_voigt); null for scalars
how_to_read.rel_tol: pass/fail tolerance on |computed - reference| / reference; chosen to reflect the spread expected between correct PBE implementations (code, pseudopotential/PAW vs all-electron, k-mesh, strain protocol), and to be smaller than the LDA-PBE difference (a0 ~1-1.5 %, Cij ~5-10 %) so that a wrong functional fails
how_to_read.confidence: high = number read in the primary source or its published data file; medium = read in the arXiv version only (published version not checked) or derived by a stated identity
how_to_read.static_lattice: all values are 0 K static-lattice DFT (no zero-point motion); never compare them with experiment without that correction

sources.ACWF2024: E. Bosoni et al., How to verify the precision of density-functional-theory implementations via reproducible and universal workflows, Nat. Rev. Phys. 6, 45-58 (2024), doi:10.1038/s42254-023-00655-3; data: Materials Cloud Archive doi:10.24435/materialscloud:s4-3h (record yf0rj-w3r97), file ACWF-verification-data-and-scripts.zip (md5 6bd97a883b439507d0be4638c1bc7514), reference-dataset/results-unaries-verification-PBE-v1-AE-average.json: all-electron PBE (average of WIEN2k and FLEUR) Birch-Murnaghan fits, X/Diamond entries, 2-atom primitive cells; V0 in angstrom^3 per cell and B0 in eV/angstrom^3 converted here (a0 = (4 V0)^(1/3), 1 eV/angstrom^3 = 160.2176634 GPa)
sources.Rasander2015: M. Rasander and M. A. Moram, On the accuracy of commonly used density functional approximations in determining the elastic constants of insulators and semiconductors, J. Chem. Phys. 143, 144104 (2015), doi:10.1063/1.4932334; numbers read in arXiv:1505.02379v1 Tables II-VI (PBE column): VASP PAW, 800 eV cutoff, Gamma-centred k spacing 0.1 1/angstrom, stress-strain Hooke's law, B = (C11 + 2 C12)/3
sources.Ramakers2022: S. Ramakers, A. Marusczyk, M. Amsler, T. Eckl, M. Mrovec, T. Hammerschmidt, R. Drautz, Effects of thermal, elastic, and surface properties on the stability of SiC polytypes, Phys. Rev. B 106, 075201 (2022), doi:10.1103/PhysRevB.106.075201; Table III (VASP-PBE, finite distortions + DFPT internal relaxation, relaxed ion), read in arXiv:2201.05379 and already recorded in data/reference_values/sic_3c.json (confidence high there)
